expect: two differences on one tab, plus the API reading beside them. (0) the toggle description under 'Switch model by request': 'Load a downloaded GGUF named in an API request before serving.' -> 'Load a downloaded model named in an API request before serving.' (the twelve-locale i18n change; en shown). (1) Usage examples: BEFORE has nothing to name and shows 'Load or download a model to see runnable examples. This server has no model to name yet.', AFTER shows a runnable curl/Python snippet whose model field reads unsloth/Qwen3-0.6B. That block is fed by GET /v1/models, so it moves only because the backend catalog did. API: /v1/models data [] -> exactly one row, id unsloth/Qwen3-0.6B, loaded false, NO quant key (its quantization is baked into the weights). POST /v1/chat/completions naming that id: 404 model_not_found 'is not downloaded on this server' -> 200 with the same id echoed in the response's model field, loaded on demand through the orchestrator. CONTROL, and the honest limit of this host: mlx-community/Qwen3-0.6B-4bit sits in the same cache and must be ABSENT from /v1/models on BOTH sides. This box is CUDA (RTX 3080), so _quantization_suits_host withholds an MLX group_size checkpoint from the Transformers backend by design. The pair therefore proves the non-GGUF catalog + auto-switch path the PR adds, exercised through the orchestrator on CUDA; the MLX backend leg (mlx-lm load, the max_seq_length clamp in mlx_inference.py) is Apple-silicon only and cannot be photographed here. Say that in the comment. ISOLATION, learned the hard way on the first probe run: HOME must be overridden for the launched Studios as well as HF_HOME, since _build_index also scans hf_default_cache_dir()/legacy_hf_cache_dir(), which come off HOME. With HF_HOME alone this box's ambient ~/.cache/huggingface put EIGHT models in /v1/models, GGUFs included, so BEFORE had something to name and the usage-examples half of the pair would have gone identical for a reason unrelated to the PR.
